retrieval.method: GitHub Actions CI runner fetch (opendata.cern.ch is blocked from this repo's own sandbox: 403 on CONNECT, confirmed directly with curl)
retrieval.readBackMethod: Each shard job printed its assigned, explicitly line-numbered row range plus a SHA-256 header (shard 0) into its own job log; content was read back via the GitHub Actions job-logs API, reassembled by line number across all 4 shards, and the reconstructed file's SHA-256 verified to match the value already hardcoded in cms_zmumu_worker.py::EXPECTED_SHA256 exactly.
